plan.rationale: Initial baseline plan per staged policy. Core portable domains only: block_M [32,64,128], block_N [64,128], block_K [32,64], num_stages [1,2,3], threads [128], swizzle [0]. All tiles divide M=N=K=4096. Shared-memory cap 32768 bytes (within allowed [8192,49152], also satisfying the hard portability cap) gates the largest tiles: e.g. 2*block_K*(block_M+block_N)*num_stages and 4*block_M*block_N must fit; largest candidates like 128x128x64x3 exceed the cap and will be excluded by HiGHS. Weights are equal (1 each) to avoid workload-specific bias before any measurements; traffic, launches, pipeline, and footprint contribute symmetrically so the first solve reveals structural tradeoffs rather than encoding a guess. Swizzle is restricted to 0 (row-major) to establish the conventional baseline; locality via serpentine panels will be explored in the next plan with swizzle [4,8,16]. No observations yet: this is the first plan with empty history, so no exclusions are applied and no numerical, simulator, or compile claims are made. Next hypothesis: after this baseline, retain core tile/stage/thread domains and introduce swizzle [4,8,16] to test whether panel locality improves the traffic proxy without exceeding the 32 KB shared-memory estimate.

Second plan per staged policy: baseline attempt-00 passed numerically, compiled with 32768 smem/122 regs, simulated 2558.09 us at 128x64x64, stages=1, swizzle=0 (3 blocks/SM). Retain core tile/stage/thread domains and hold equal weights (no measurements yet justify reweighting). Only change: introduce swizzle [4,8,16] to test whether serpentine panel locality improves the analytic reuse and reduces simulated DRAM traffic on this 4096^3 workload. Tiles still divide M=N=K=4096; shared-memory estimate gates oversized combos via HiGHS under the 32768 cap (also within the 32768 hard portability cap). Deduplication note: M/block_M ranges 32-128 tile rows, so swizzle 4/8/16 are distinct panels here, not launch-equivalent. Hypothesis: nonzero panel reuse should lower traffic cost and simulated dram_mb; if simulator traffic/latency does not improve, the locality proxy is misleading and I will change the thread or block_K domain next rather than sweeping more swizzles. Simulation values are GB10 estimates, not hardware measurements; Metal checks validate source but do not execute CUDA binaries.
